variants.name: 守烬幼龙
variants.desc: Hearth-Ember young dragon: charcoal-gray soft reptile scales, warm ivory belly, dark burnt-wood-looking dorsal spines in the exact source silhouette, modest amber eyes with a protective gentle expression, a tiny tied dark-red cloth neck knot (short flush ends). One main uncanny trait: fine amber ember fissures beneath throat scales and inside mouth, like a safe hearth containing a strange ancient fire. Rounded cheeks, slightly stubborn companion personality. No extra horns, no wings, no jewelry.

variants.name: 眠月幼龙
variants.desc: Sleeping-Moon young dragon: smoky slate-blue matte skin, old pale porcelain-colored belly and horns, same source dorsal ridge silhouette. Soft sleepy luminous pearl eyes, a small crescent-shaped CLOSED-EYELID marking inside translucent throat scales (NOT a physical floating moon, not extra eyes everywhere). Main uncanny trait: faint inward milky mist visible under throat and tail skin. Gentle but quietly alien, loyal expression. Restrained muted burgundy tiny collar knot.

variants.name: 旧书脊龙
variants.desc: Old-Book-Spine young dragon: supple old dark-umber leather-like scale skin, cream parchment belly, existing dorsal ridge rendered as layered worn book-page edges within SAME silhouette, horn shapes as aged dark horn. Big warm muted brass eyes and soft muzzle. One uncanny trait: a few faint ink letters trapped under translucent cream throat scales. Tiny faded red bookmark-shaped collar tab close to body. Tender ancient-library guardian, no wings, no extra appendages, not mechanical.
